blurb: CNY Karate Discover the tradition and discipline of authentic Okinawan martial arts at CNY Okinawan Karate & Kobudo School. Established in 1963, our dojo is dedicated to preserving and teaching Okinawan GoJu Ryu Karate-Do and Okinawan Kobudo in an environment where students can grow in strength, confidence, focus, and character.
